mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Purchase_Order (publisher_id, employee_id, status, order_date) VALUES (#{publisher_id}, #{employee_id}, 'REQUESTED', SYSTIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO Purchase_Order_Item (po_id, book_id, order_qty, receive_qty) VALUES (#{po_id}, #{book_id}, #{order_qty}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT po.po_id, po.publisher_id, po.employee_id, po.status, po.order_date, p.name AS publisher_name, e.name AS employee_name FROM Purchase_Order po LEFT JOIN Publisher p ON po.publisher_id = p.publisher_id LEFT JOIN Employee e ON po.employee_id = e.employee_id ORDER BY po.po_id DESC

SELECT poi.po_item_id, poi.po_id, poi.book_id, poi.order_qty, poi.receive_qty, b.title AS book_title, b.isbn FROM Purchase_Order_Item poi JOIN Book b ON poi.book_id = b.book_id WHERE poi.po_id = #{po_id} ORDER BY poi.po_item_id ASC
